verses.text: A gentle answer cools down anger. A harsh word heats it back up.
Wise people make knowledge worth hearing. Foolishness pours out of the mouths of fools.
The LORD's eyes are everywhere, watching people who do evil and people who do good.
Gentle words are a tree of life. Deceitful words crush the spirit.
A fool looks down on their father's correction. Someone who listens to correction shows good judgment.
There's plenty of treasure in the home of people who do right. The earnings of the wicked bring trouble.
Wise people spread knowledge when they speak. The hearts of fools have nothing like that to share.
The LORD detests the sacrifices of the wicked. The prayers of people who live uprightly delight him.
The LORD detests the way the wicked live. He loves anyone who pursues what's right.
Hard discipline comes to those who leave the path. Anyone who hates correction will die.
Even Sheol and Abaddon lie open before the LORD. How much more the hearts of human beings!
A mocker hates being corrected and won't go to wise people for advice.
A happy heart lights up your face. Heartache breaks your spirit.
An understanding heart seeks knowledge. The mouths of fools feed on foolishness.
For someone who's suffering, every day is hard. A cheerful heart enjoys a feast that never ends.
It's better to have a little and revere the LORD than to have piles of treasure and trouble with it.
A meal of greens with people who love you beats a fattened calf served with hatred.
A hothead starts fights. Someone slow to anger settles them down.
A slacker's road is like a patch of thorns. The path of the upright is a highway.
A wise son makes his father glad. A fool looks down on his mother.
People who lack wisdom have fun doing foolish things. Someone with understanding keeps to a straight path.
Plans fall apart without advice. Get plenty of good advisers and your plans stand firm.
Giving a good answer brings you joy. How good it is to hear the right word at the right time!
For wise people the path of life leads up, keeping them from going down to Sheol.
The LORD uproots the house of the proud, but he keeps a widow's boundaries intact.
The LORD detests the thoughts of the wicked. The thoughts of people who are pure please him.
Greed for profit brings trouble home. Anyone who hates bribes will live.
People who do right think before they answer. The wicked let evil pour out of their mouths.
The LORD is far from the wicked. He hears the prayers of those who do right.
Bright eyes bring joy to the heart. Good news brings health to the bones. ✨
Listen to correction that gives life, and you'll be at home among wise people.
Reject correction and you show contempt for your own life. Listen to it and you'll gain understanding.
Reverence for the LORD teaches wisdom. Humility comes before honor.
